notes: []bool uses one byte per flag; init: index >= 2 marks 2..N as candidates in one pass.
V's int is always 32 bits: p * p and m + p stay below 2^31 for N ≤ 200000000. Indexing keeps V's default bounds checks.
The three result lines are built with string interpolation and written to os.stdout() in one call.
